scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @pokerorga/api" "npm run dev -w @pokerorga/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pokerorga/web && npm run build -w @pokerorga/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pokerorga/shared && npm run test -w @pokerorga/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pokerorga/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pokerorga/api && npm run typecheck -w @pokerorga/web
